thesis: 기계적 core score는 약 78.62로 Emerging Outlier이며 archetype은 Compounder다. OpenAI 보정 후 MT·RF·MA·FS·EV 조건이 모두 Compounder threshold를 통과하고 price/Base≈0.438이다. Hard Veto는 cleared. 기계적 상태는 NORMAL_CANDIDATE, 2–4%이며 macro pacing 0.7을 적용한다. 핵심 검증 포인트는 HBM 구조성장이 메모리 사이클 정상화 이후에도 높은 owner FCF/share로 남는지다.

evidence.claim: Expected aggregate score is about 78.62 with Compounder archetype.
H1 2026 OCF 91.743T and PP&E purchases 18.329T support reinvestment capacity.
Liquid net cash ~69.37T supports survival and optionality.

counterevidence: The valuation is sensitive to normalized FCF because H1 2026 may be near a cycle peak.
DRAM/HBM concentration can create correlated downside.
The calibration remains provisional and based on one paired NVDA sample.
falsifiers: If RF falls below 76 or price/Base rises above 1.2, Compounder status should be reconsidered.
If HBM economics normalize sharply, rerun EV and MT.
